summary: Bootstrap A.5 as a repository/PR mechanical presence-and-coverage gate without semantic source parsing or runtime authority.

components.disposition: ADMIT as mechanical PR review gate; no runtime or semantic qualification authority
components.verification_level: deterministic unit tests + staged/committed exact diff self-coverage + CI workflow inspection
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: The gate reports exact missing/extra paths and missing structural fields; submitter/reviewer can amend classification/declarations and rerun. Semantic quality remains model/human review-owned.
components.rollback_route: Revert the Step5 commit to remove the PR status job/checker/schema/template wiring; runtime behavior is unaffected.

g1.necessity: A.5 explicitly requires submission/review enforcement. Exact diff-path coverage and required-field presence are mechanical facts that cannot be guaranteed by model judgment alone without a repository check.

g2.authority_owner: CONVERGENCE A.5 architecture-review policy and the submitter-authored changed-component manifest
g2.non_duplication: The checker owns no runtime state, task completion, scorer verdict, control classification, or G1-G4 semantic judgment; it only compares declared structure with Git diff facts.

g3.recovery_or_reason: Edit the submission manifest or split/reclassify the PR and rerun the checker. There is no runtime refusal or hidden model-side override because this gate exists only in repository review.

g4.rollback: Revert the Step5 gate commit; no service/runtime migration or durable application state is introduced.
verification: TDD negative tests for missing G1-G4 and file-matrix fields
explicit test proving vague semantic prose still passes structural validation
staged and committed self-application against the exact Step5 diff
